production_structure: L0 parameter-consistent pre-1961 equilibrium + hydrology-coupled mineral/lower dissolved N + routed hydraulic exposure + global C-Q hinge
final_training: all formal river-channel TN observations from 2021-2024
retrospective_back_report: 2016-2020 observations; explicitly reverse-time descriptive evaluation, not OOF or external validation
forcing: CENTRAL effective monthly availability calendar; Reach-year mass unchanged
p2: ridge=12 station training-history intercept, exported separately; never applied to unmonitored Reach products

required_fields: source-tagged local fast and slow N loads
global P1 C-Q adjusted TN concentration
frozen hydrology provenance and water volume

claim_boundary: temporal OOF and held-out Reach support passed
whole-terminal-tree transfer did not pass because only seven independent trees produced wide uncertainty
230-Reach output is a model application, not proof of uniform spatial accuracy
P2 improves previously monitored stations but is not spatially transferable
fixed agricultural Legacy candidates were not supported
EARLY/LATE calendars are sensitivity scenarios, not observed fertilizer dates
2024 FERT/MAN/BNF and post-2020 deposition/spatial crop-area extensions remain forcing limitations
forbidden: new data, parameters, structures or post-result gate changes
temperature, WWTP, SAS, fitted groundwater age or hydrology refit
spinup_verification: The differentiable periodic solution is independently checked against explicit 1961-1970 cycling to absolute terminal delta <=1e-6 kg N; the verification ceiling is 10000 cycles and does not alter fitted equations.
